en: Vintage multiview lithographic postcard with vignettes of the city and surroundings: a panoramic view of Hermannstadt (Sibiu), the Großer Ring (Grand Square), the Natural History Museum, Michelsberg (Cisnădioara) hill/fort, and Salzburg (Ocna Sibiului). Front bears the printed title "Gruss aus Hermannstadt Salzburg Michelsberg." with handwritten German message. Reverse shows Hungarian 'Levelező-lap' layout, a Magyar Kir. Posta stamp and Nagy-Szeben postmarks, addressed to Vienna (Hernals).
